name: Breakout
description: Breakout turns your website visitors into qualified meetings, without adding headcount.

logo.source: The app's wordmark: 'break' in #1C1778, 'out' in #4E46DC (matches the colour classes in the Drive SVGs and the product screenshots). Geometry from Breakout_logo 8.svg in brand/source/. The mark is the indigo b-disc the app uses as its favicon.

copy.source: Breakout Brand Guide for Writers and the Referral Partner Enablement guide (team Drive). Re-run the extractor on getbreakout.ai to pull the live site's h1, h2s and features.
copy.subhead: Breakout turns your website visitors into qualified meetings, without adding headcount.
h2: Every visit is a growth opportunity.
Websites should adapt to each buyer the moment they arrive.
Speed-to-lead and orchestration beat bloated headcount.
one_liners: Breakout turns your website visitors into qualified meetings, without adding headcount.
Breakout is an AI SDR that turns your website traffic into handraisers.
A full-time, always-on SDR that never misses a website visitor.
ctas: See an AI SDR qualify and book in minutes, not months.
features: Identifies the visitor: company, person, buying group and intent signals
Engages them in real time: answers questions, shares content, qualifies and books meetings
Converts drop-offs with personalized email and LinkedIn follow-ups
copy.voice: Challenger brand. Direct, contrarian, confident, optimistic about AI. Short sentences, one idea per line, no fluff. Lead with a clear verdict.

palette_notes.app_ui_blue: #2d91fa (product UI only, e.g. the relevance ring; not a brand colour)
